items.summary: Validation used a proxy microbenchmark; never exercised OCTproZ app kernels, GL-interop, or the 3D-volume surface-write path (riskiest ported feature compiled but not run) on real GPU. Re-validate by launching the built app through its OCT processing pipeline.

Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: octproz_project/octproz/aboutdata/thirdparty_licenses/cuda_license.txt is a disclosure copy of the NVIDIA CUDA EULA shown in the about dialog. Almost certainly benign (documenting the toolkit licence, not licensing project code), but no ruling is recorded; needs a person's confirmation.
